C1627.title: Deep Synthesis Technology Abuse Case: $35 Million Scammed via Fake Executive Voice Cloning
C1627.summary: Reports indicate that criminals previously used deep synthesis technology to forge a corporate executive's voice, successfully defrauding $35 million. Dubbed the 'first major deepfake case,' this incident highlights the immense harm of AI voice cloning for financial fraud, posing serious threats to both corporate and personal assets.

references.title: Caution! The Two Sides of Deep Synthesis Technology
